RemediationStrings.Title: CrowdStrike Falcon sensor is not operational
RemediationStrings.Description: The Falcon sensor is not running on this Mac. Restart the Mac and wait a few minutes. If it stays non-compliant, contact the IT Service Desk.

RemediationStrings.Title: CrowdStrike Falcon sensor is not loaded. Status found: {ActualValue}
RemediationStrings.Description: The Falcon sensor is installed but not loaded. Restart the Mac. If the status does not change to 'loaded', contact the IT Service Desk.

RemediationStrings.Title: CrowdStrike Falcon has not connected to the cloud in the last 30 days. Days since last connection: {ActualValue}
RemediationStrings.Description: This Mac has not established a connection to the CrowdStrike cloud recently, so its security status cannot be verified. Connect to the corporate network or VPN, restart the Mac, and press Retry. If it stays non-compliant, contact the IT Service Desk.
